import pandas as pd

# Load the time_series_data.csv dataset
df_time_series = pd.read_csv('/data/time_series_data.csv')

# Load the capital.csv dataset
df_capital = pd.read_csv('/data/capital.csv')

# Identify the column for Depot in the time_series_data dataset
depot_column = 'Depot'

# Extract the 'CE' and 'Depot' columns
df_depot = df_time_series[['CE', depot_column]]

# Find the row with the maximum 'Depot' value
max_depot_row = df_depot.loc[df_depot[depot_column].idxmax()]

# Determine the century based on the 'CE' value
ce_value = max_depot_row['CE']
century = (ce_value // 100) + 1 if ce_value >= 0 else (ce_value // 100) - 1

century
